generate_craft_recipes_header: run the script to generate a craft_recipes.h C++ header file from items.ini and crafting.txt
parse_items_ini: parse an items.ini file to build a name to id and metadata mapping
fill_recipe: fill a 3x3 crafting grid recipe array with ingredients at specified or wildcard locations
parse_crafting_txt: parse a crafting.txt file with pipe-separated ingredients and wildcard location syntax into recipe data
format_recipe: format a recipe tuple into C++ initializer syntax for the craft_recipes.h header output
